commands.name: citizens
commands.label: Plugin info
commands.description: Shows basic Citizens plugin information.

commands.name: citizens-reload
commands.label: Reload Citizens
commands.description: Loads Citizens fresh from disk without saving first; by default the command must be repeated within 5 seconds to confirm.

commands.name: citizens-save
commands.label: Save NPCs
commands.description: Saves all NPCs to disk.

commands.name: npc-create
commands.label: Create NPC
commands.description: Creates a new NPC at the given location; extra flags such as -b, -u, -s, -t, --trait or --nameplate may be appended to the name.

commands.name: npc-list
commands.label: List NPCs
commands.description: Lists NPCs, optionally filtered with -a, --owner, --type, --registry, --tag or --filter.

commands.name: npc-select
commands.label: Select NPC
commands.description: Selects an NPC with the given ID or name.

commands.name: npc-deselect
commands.label: Deselect NPC
commands.description: Deselects the currently selected NPC.

commands.name: npc-spawn
commands.label: Spawn NPC
commands.description: Spawns an existing NPC at its stored location.

commands.name: npc-despawn
commands.label: Despawn NPC
commands.description: Despawns an NPC.

commands.name: npc-remove
commands.label: Remove NPC
commands.description: Removes an NPC by ID or name, or all NPCs with all (also accepts --owner, --eid or --world).

commands.name: npc-tpto
commands.label: Teleport entity to entity
commands.description: Teleports an NPC or player to another NPC or player.

commands.name: npc-undo
commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Undoes the last action (currently only create/remove supported).

commands.name: npc-showshop
commands.label: Show shop to player
commands.description: Shows the named NPC shop to the given player.

commands.name: npc-shopitem-reset_purchases
commands.label: Reset shop purchases
commands.description: Resets purchase records for a shop item, or for all items with all.

commands.name: npc
commands.label: Selected NPC info
commands.description: Shows basic information about the selected NPC (select one first with npc select).

commands.name: npc-tphere
commands.label: Teleport NPC to location
commands.description: Teleports the NPC to the given location (console uses --location).

commands.name: npc-rename
commands.label: Rename NPC
commands.description: Renames an NPC.

commands.name: npc-copy
commands.label: Copy NPC
commands.description: Copies an NPC, optionally giving the copy a new name with --name.

commands.name: npc-type
commands.label: Set entity type
commands.description: Sets an NPC's entity type.

commands.name: npc-owner
commands.label: Set owner
commands.description: Sets the owner of an NPC.

commands.name: npc-skin
commands.label: Set skin
commands.description: Sets an NPC's skin from a player name; use -l to always update to the latest skin, or --url / -t for custom skins.

commands.name: npc-skinlayers
commands.label: Skin layers
commands.description: Sets an NPC's skin layer visibility.

commands.name: npc-name
commands.label: Nameplate visibility
commands.description: Toggles nameplate visibility, or only shows names on hover with -h.

commands.name: npc-respawn
commands.label: Respawn delay
commands.description: Sets an NPC's respawn delay.

commands.name: npc-moveto
commands.label: Move to location
commands.description: Teleports an NPC to a given location.

commands.name: npc-speak
commands.label: Speak
commands.description: Says a message from the NPC (supports --target, --range and --bubble).

commands.name: npc-speed
commands.label: Set speed
commands.description: Sets the movement speed of an NPC as a percentage.

commands.name: npc-hurt
commands.label: Damage NPC
commands.description: Damages the NPC.

commands.name: npc-jump
commands.label: Jump
commands.description: Makes the NPC jump.

commands.name: npc-velocity
commands.label: Set velocity
commands.description: Sets the NPC's velocity.

commands.name: npc-scaledmaxhealth
commands.label: Max health
commands.description: Controls the max health of an NPC, can use large numbers.

commands.name: npc-attribute
commands.label: Set attribute
commands.description: Sets various NPC attributes.

commands.name: npc-age
commands.label: Set age
commands.description: Sets the age of an NPC; use -l to lock age over time.

commands.name: npc-activationrange
commands.label: Activation range
commands.description: Sets the activation range.

commands.name: npc-trackingrange
commands.label: Tracking range
commands.description: Sets the tracking range.

commands.name: npc-entitypose
commands.label: Entity pose
commands.description: Controls entity pose.

commands.name: npc-metadata
commands.label: Metadata
commands.description: Manages NPC metadata (set, get or remove a key; -t for temporary).

commands.name: npc-item
commands.label: Set item
commands.description: Sets the NPC's item.

commands.name: npc-setequipment
commands.label: Set equipment
commands.description: Sets equipment via commands (-c for cosmetic).

inputs.name: slot
inputs.label: Slot
inputs.placeholder: e.g. HAND, OFF_HAND, HEAD, CHEST, LEGS, FEET

commands.name: npc-playsound
commands.label: Play sound
commands.description: Plays a sound at the NPC's location (optionally category, volume, pitch, --to, --at).

commands.name: npc-panimate
commands.label: Player animation
commands.description: Plays a player animation.

commands.name: npc-ai
commands.label: Vanilla AI
commands.description: Sets whether the NPC should use vanilla AI.

commands.name: npc-flyable
commands.label: Flyable
commands.description: Toggles or sets an NPC's flyable status.

commands.name: npc-aggressive
commands.label: Aggressive
commands.description: Sets the aggressive status of the entity.

commands.name: npc-gravity
commands.label: Toggle gravity
commands.description: Toggles gravity.

commands.name: npc-targetable
commands.label: Toggle targetable
commands.description: Toggles an NPC's targetability.

commands.name: npc-leashable
commands.label: Toggle leashable
commands.description: Toggles leashability.

commands.name: npc-vulnerable
commands.label: Toggle vulnerable
commands.description: Toggles an NPC's vulnerability (-t for temporary).

commands.name: npc-chunkload
commands.label: Toggle chunk loading
commands.description: Toggles the NPC forcing chunks to stay loaded (-t for temporary).

commands.name: npc-collidable
commands.label: Toggle collidable
commands.description: Toggles an NPC's collidability.

commands.name: npc-knockback
commands.label: Toggle knockback
commands.description: Toggles NPC knockback.

commands.name: npc-nophysics
commands.label: No physics
commands.description: Manages no physics settings.

commands.name: npc-glowing
commands.label: Toggle glowing
commands.description: Toggles an NPC's glowing status.

commands.name: npc-passive
commands.label: Passive
commands.description: Sets whether an NPC damages other entities or not.

commands.name: npc-pickupitems
commands.label: Pick up items
commands.description: Allows the NPC to pick up items.

commands.name: npc-swim
commands.label: Swim
commands.description: Sets an NPC to swim or not.

commands.name: npc-useitem
commands.label: Use held item
commands.description: Sets an NPC to be using their held items (-o for offhand).

commands.name: npc-sitting
commands.label: Sitting
commands.description: Sets the NPC sitting.

commands.name: npc-packet
commands.label: Packet NPC
commands.description: Controls packet NPC settings.

commands.name: npc-mirror
commands.label: Mirror
commands.description: Controls mirroring of NPC skins and more.

commands.name: npc-controllable
commands.label: Controllable
commands.description: Toggles whether the NPC can be ridden and controlled.

commands.name: npc-lookclose
commands.label: Look close
commands.description: Toggles whether an NPC will look when a player is near.

commands.name: npc-sound
commands.label: Sounds
commands.description: Sets an NPC's played sounds.

commands.name: npc-disguise
commands.label: Disguise
commands.description: Manages entity disguises.

commands.name: npc-hitbox
commands.label: Hitbox
commands.description: Sets the NPC hitbox.

commands.name: npc-forcefield
commands.label: Forcefield
commands.description: Creates a forcefield which pushes players close to the NPC away.

commands.name: npc-pathopt
commands.label: Pathfinding options
commands.description: Sets an NPC's pathfinding options.

commands.name: npc-pausepathfinding
commands.label: Pathfinding pause
commands.description: Sets pathfinding pause.

commands.name: npc-playerfilter
commands.label: Player filter
commands.description: Manages the NPC's player filter.

commands.name: npc-home
commands.label: Home location
commands.description: Controls home location (use --location from console).

commands.name: npc-pose
commands.label: Poses
commands.description: Manages NPC poses.

commands.name: npc-rotate
commands.label: Rotate
commands.description: Rotates the NPC.

commands.name: npc-anchor
commands.label: Anchors
commands.description: Manages the NPC's location anchors; without flags lists them (from console, --save uses --location).

commands.name: npc-debug
commands.label: Debug
commands.description: Displays debugging information.

commands.name: npc-armorstand
commands.label: Armor stand
commands.description: Edits armorstand properties.

commands.name: npc-bat
commands.label: Bat
commands.description: Sets bat modifiers.

commands.name: npc-endercrystal
commands.label: End crystal
commands.description: Edits endercrystal modifiers.

commands.name: npc-enderman
commands.label: Enderman
commands.description: Sets enderman modifiers.

commands.name: npc-horse
commands.label: Horse
commands.description: Sets horse and horse-like entity modifiers.

commands.name: npc-itemframe
commands.label: Item frame
commands.description: Sets itemframe modifiers.

commands.name: npc-minecart
commands.label: Minecart
commands.description: Sets minecart item.

commands.name: npc-ocelot
commands.label: Ocelot
commands.description: Sets the ocelot type of an NPC and whether it is sitting.

commands.name: npc-painting
commands.label: Painting
commands.description: Sets painting modifiers.

commands.name: npc-powered
commands.label: Powered creeper
commands.description: Toggles a creeper NPC as powered.

commands.name: npc-sheep
commands.label: Sheep
commands.description: Sets sheep modifiers.

commands.name: npc-wither
commands.label: Wither
commands.description: Sets wither modifiers.

commands.name: npc-wolf
commands.label: Wolf
commands.description: Sets wolf modifiers.

commands.name: npc-playerlist
commands.label: Player list
commands.description: Sets whether the NPC is put in the playerlist.

commands.name: npc-wander
commands.label: Wander
commands.description: Sets the NPC to wander around.

commands.name: npc-gamemode
commands.label: Game mode
commands.description: Changes the gamemode.

commands.name: npc-rabbittype
commands.label: Rabbit type
commands.description: Sets the NPC's rabbit type.

commands.name: npc-slimesize
commands.label: Slime size
commands.description: Sets the NPC's slime size.

commands.name: npc-rotationsettings
commands.label: Rotation settings
commands.description: Edits NPC rotation settings.

commands.name: npc-follow
commands.label: Follow
commands.description: Toggles the NPC following the given player or NPC.

commands.name: npc-target
commands.label: Target entity
commands.description: Targets a given entity (-a aggressive, -c cancel).

commands.name: npc-pathto
commands.label: Pathfind to
commands.description: Starts pathfinding to a certain location.

commands.name: npc-behavior
commands.label: Behavior tree
commands.description: Manages behavior trees.

commands.name: npc-hologram-add
commands.label: Add hologram line
commands.description: Adds a hologram line (optionally with --duration).

commands.name: npc-hologram-insert
commands.label: Insert hologram line
commands.description: Inserts a hologram line at the given index.

commands.name: npc-hologram-set
commands.label: Set hologram line
commands.description: Sets the text of a hologram line.

commands.name: npc-hologram-remove
commands.label: Remove hologram line
commands.description: Removes a hologram line.

commands.name: npc-hologram-clear
commands.label: Clear hologram
commands.description: Clears all hologram lines.

commands.name: npc-hologram-lineheight
commands.label: Hologram line height
commands.description: Sets the hologram line height.

commands.name: npc-hologram-viewrange
commands.label: Hologram view range
commands.description: Sets the hologram view range.

commands.name: npc-hologram-verticalviewrange
commands.label: Hologram vertical view range
commands.description: Sets the hologram vertical view range.

commands.name: npc-hologram-updaterate
commands.label: Hologram update rate
commands.description: Sets the hologram update rate in ticks.

commands.name: npc-hologram-margintop
commands.label: Hologram top margin
commands.description: Sets the top margin of a hologram line.

commands.name: npc-hologram-marginbottom
commands.label: Hologram bottom margin
commands.description: Sets the bottom margin of a hologram line.

commands.name: npc-hologram-bgcolor
commands.label: Hologram background color
commands.description: Sets the background color of a hologram line.

commands.name: npc-command
commands.label: List NPC commands
commands.description: Lists the commands which will be run when clicking on the NPC.

commands.name: npc-command-add
commands.label: Add NPC command
commands.description: Adds a command run when clicking the NPC (flags such as -l, -r, -p, -o, --cooldown, --delay or --n may be included).

commands.name: npc-command-remove
commands.label: Remove NPC command
commands.description: Removes an NPC command by ID, or all commands.

commands.name: npc-command-execute
commands.label: Execute NPC commands
commands.description: Triggers assigned commands as if the given player clicked the NPC.

commands.name: npc-command-permissions
commands.label: Grant temporary permissions
commands.description: Sets permissions granted to the clicking player, optionally for a duration.

commands.name: npc-command-cost
commands.label: Command cost
commands.description: Sets the money cost of the NPC commands.

commands.name: npc-command-expcost
commands.label: Command experience cost
commands.description: Sets the experience cost of the NPC commands.

commands.name: npc-command-sequential
commands.label: Toggle sequential mode
commands.description: Toggles running NPC commands sequentially.

commands.name: npc-command-cycle
commands.label: Toggle cycle mode
commands.description: Toggles cycling through NPC commands.

commands.name: npc-command-random
commands.label: Toggle random mode
commands.description: Toggles running a random NPC command.

commands.name: npc-command-hideerrors
commands.label: Toggle error messages
commands.description: Toggles hiding of NPC command error messages.

commands.name: npc-command-forgetplayer
commands.label: Forget player
commands.description: Forgets command usage data for a player.

commands.name: npc-command-clearerror
commands.label: Clear command errors
commands.description: Clears stored command errors of the given type for a player.

commands.name: npc-command-errormessage
commands.label: Custom error message
commands.description: Sets a custom error message for the given error type.

commands.name: trait
commands.label: Toggle traits
commands.description: Toggles traits on the NPC.

commands.name: trait-add
commands.label: Add traits
commands.description: Adds traits to the NPC.

commands.name: trait-remove
commands.label: Remove traits
commands.description: Removes traits on the NPC.

commands.name: trait-clearsaves
commands.label: Clear trait saves
commands.description: Clears trait information from saves.

commands.name: template-list
commands.label: List templates
commands.description: Lists available templates.

commands.name: template-apply
commands.label: Apply template
commands.description: Applies a template to the NPC.

commands.name: template-generate
commands.label: Generate template
commands.description: Generates a template from the NPC.

commands.name: waypoints-add
commands.label: Add waypoint
commands.description: Adds a waypoint at a point.

commands.name: waypoints-remove
commands.label: Remove waypoint
commands.description: Removes a waypoint at a point or by --index.

commands.name: waypoints-provider
commands.label: Waypoint provider
commands.description: Sets the current waypoint provider.
